roster.name: Modular assembly
roster.note: built up in orbit over a decade — the Core module (1986), then Kvant, Kvant-2, Kristall, Spektr and Priroda — the first station assembled from separately-launched modules

roster.name: Polyakov — 437 days
roster.note: Valeri Polyakov's single stay of 437 days aboard Mir remains the longest continuous human spaceflight ever, proving a crew could survive a Mars-duration mission

roster.name: Shuttle-Mir
roster.note: US Space Shuttles docked with Mir and American astronauts lived aboard (1995-1998) — the Cold-War rivals' first joint station operations, and the direct rehearsal for the ISS

roster.name: The 1997 crises
roster.note: an onboard fire and then a Progress freighter collision that punctured the Spektr module and depressurised part of the station — the worst collision a crew has survived in orbit
